name: ontocode-desktop
description: OntoCode Studio Ontology Editor – Desktop (Electron + bundled backend)
author: OntoCode Studio

scripts.dist: npm run prepare-resources && npm run build-web && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare-resources && npm run build-web && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare-resources && npm run build-web && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare-resources && npm run build-web && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:linux:flatpak: npm run prepare-resources && npm run build-web && electron-builder --linux flatpak
scripts.dist:win:dev: npm run prepare-resources && npm run build-web && electron-builder --win -c.publish.url=https://ontocodedevapi.selfresearch.org/api/downloads/updates/win
scripts.dist:mac:dev: npm run prepare-resources && npm run build-web && electron-builder --mac -c.publish.url=https://ontocodedevapi.selfresearch.org/api/downloads/updates/mac
scripts.dist:linux:dev: npm run prepare-resources && npm run build-web && electron-builder --linux -c.publish.url=https://ontocodedevapi.selfresearch.org/api/downloads/updates/linux
